summary: Iteration 87 - UOM decimal_places feature and BOM dialog improvements. All backend tests passed (9/9). Frontend features verified: UOM decimal_places in Settings, formatQty() in Inventory/Items/BOM pages, BOM dialog Escape/outside-click prevention, component auto-scroll.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features from iteration 87 verified: (1) UOM decimal_places field works - POST/PUT/GET endpoints accept and persist decimal_places (0-6, default 2, clamped), (2) Settings page shows 'Decimals' column in UOM table and 'Decimal Places' input in Add/Edit dialog, (3) formatQty() used in Inventory Stock table, Items page Stock column, and BOM explosion grids, (4) BOM Create/Edit dialog does NOT close on Escape or outside-click (onEscapeKeyDown/onPointerDownOutside/onInteractOutside preventDefault), (5) Add Component button auto-scrolls dialog to show new row (componentsEndRef sentinel), (6) SearchableItemSelect flips up when space below is limited.

backend_uom_decimal_places.details: 9/9 tests passed. POST with decimal_places=3 returns 3. POST with decimal_places=99 clamps to 6. POST without decimal_places defaults to 2. PUT updates persist. GET backfills decimal_places=2 for all rows.

frontend_settings_uom_decimals.details: Settings page UOM table shows 'Decimals' column. Add/Edit UOM dialog has 'Decimal Places' input (data-testid=uom-decimal-places-input) with default value 2. 15 UOMs displayed with decimal values.

frontend_inventory_formatQty.details: Inventory Stock table uses formatQty() - quantities displayed as '59.00 sheet', '67.00 meter', '341.00 kit', '16.00 pcs' etc.

frontend_items_formatQty.details: Items page Stock column uses formatQty() - same UOM-aware precision formatting.

frontend_bom_dialog_no_close_on_escape.details: BOM Create/Edit dialog does NOT close on Escape key press. onEscapeKeyDown preventDefault working.

frontend_bom_dialog_no_close_on_outside_.details: BOM Create/Edit dialog does NOT close on clicking outside (backdrop). onPointerDownOutside/onInteractOutside preventDefault working.

frontend_bom_add_component_auto_scroll.details: Add Component button appends new row and dialog scrolls to show it. componentsEndRef sentinel with scrollIntoView working.

frontend_searchable_item_select_flip.details: SearchableItemSelect uses 'space above > space below' heuristic to flip dropdown up when needed. Panel maxHeight adapts to available viewport area.

frontend_bom_save_performance.details: BOM save returns immediately via reloadBomsBackground() - explosions populate in background via setTimeout(0). No multi-second wait.

regression_tests.currency_features: Not explicitly tested but no regressions observed in UI
regression_tests.role_group_permissions: Not explicitly tested but admin login and permissions working
regression_tests.price_visibility: Not explicitly tested but prices visible in Inventory/Items pages
